metas.name: SpongeBob SquarePants
metas.description: The misadventures of a talking sea sponge who works at a fast food restaurant, attends a boating school, and lives in an underwater pineapple.

metas.name: Avatar: The Last Airbender
metas.description: After a century frozen in ice, young Avatar Aang journeys with friends to master the four elements and bring balance to a world at war with the Fire Nation.

metas.name: The Legend of Korra
metas.description: Avatar Korra fights to keep Republic City safe from the evil forces of both the physical and spiritual worlds.

metas.name: The Fairly OddParents
metas.description: After being tortured and humiliated by his babysitter, a ten year old boy is put under the care of two fairy godparents, who can grant him almost any wish, which leads to dire consequences.

metas.name: Danny Phantom
metas.description: A 14-year-old receives ghost powers and uses them to save the world.

metas.name: T.U.F.F. Puppy
metas.description: Dim-witted but enthusiastic dog Dudley Puppy is recruited into the Turbo Undercover Fighting Force (T.U.F.F.) and partnered with top feline agent Kitty Katswell to protect Petropolis.

metas.name: Rugrats
metas.description: Tommy, Chuckie, Angelica, Phil and Lil and Susie find themselves in a slew of adventures - both real and imaginary. Baldly go where no baby's every gone before as the Rugrats turn the ordinary into the extraordinary every day.

metas.name: Hey Arnold!
metas.description: The everyday life of Arnold, a fourth-grader in the city of Hillwood, Washington, who lives in a multi-racial boarding house with his grandparents and a motley assortment of friends and neighbors.

metas.name: Rocko's Modern Life
metas.description: The wacky misadventures of an Australian wallaby and his friends as he finishes his transition to American life.

metas.name: Invader ZIM
metas.description: An alien named Zim from the planet Irk is sent on a secret mission to conquer Earth, not realising that his leaders were just trying to get rid of him and hoped that he would die. Once there, Zim manages to disguise himself as a h...

metas.name: The Adventures of Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius
metas.description: A young boy, who happens to be a genius, lives in a small town with his family and friends and often gets into crazy adventures with them involving the things he invents.

metas.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
metas.description: Four ninja turtles, mutated by a mysterious alien substance, must rise up out of the sewers and defend New York City against evil forces from both the past and present.

metas.name: The Loud House
metas.description: Lincoln Loud is an eleven-year-old boy who lives with ten sisters. With the help of his right-hand man Clyde, Lincoln finds new ways to survive in such a large family every day.

metas.name: The Casagrandes
metas.description: Eleven-year-old Ronnie Anne Santiago and her brother Bobby adjust to life in Great Lakes City living above their family's bodega with their large, loving multigenerational Mexican-American family.

metas.name: CatDog
metas.description: The life and times of a cat and a dog with a unique twist: they're connected, literally. Adding to their dilemma is Cat's annoyance with Dog, mainly caused by Dog's stupidity and Cat's up-tight personality.

metas.name: The Wild Thornberrys
metas.description: Eliza Thornberry is not your ordinary kid. It's not just because she travels the world in an RV with her parents: famous nature show hosts. Eliza also happened to be granted the magical ability to talk with and understand animals.

metas.name: Rocket Power
metas.description: Four friends and their daily lives of playing extreme sports, surfing, and getting into some crazy situations.

metas.name: The Angry Beavers
metas.description: Brothers Daggett and Norbert Beaver have left home to gain independence by living on their own. Their goal is to live a wild bachelor lifestyle but, as might be expected from young brothers, they get into some weird situations.

metas.name: Aaahh!!! Real Monsters
metas.description: The show takes us through the struggles of life as a child monster. Three monster friends are studying how to scare humans in school. Often, their attempts don't work out as planned.

metas.name: My Life as a Teenage Robot
metas.description: The escapades of a super-powered robot who happens to resemble a teenage girl that tries to balance high school and teen problems while trying to save the world from danger.

metas.name: ChalkZone
metas.description: The adventures of a boy with a magic chalk stick that enables him to enter a world of chalk drawings and alter its reality at will.

metas.name: As Told by Ginger
metas.description: The TV cartoon follows a preteen girl named Ginger Foutley, along with two friends, as they try to fit in social life as well in school and try to avoid any embarrassments.

metas.name: All Grown Up!
metas.description: Follows the adventures of an older Rugrats gang.

metas.name: The Ren & Stimpy Show
metas.description: Ren, a psychotic Chihuahua, and Stimpson J. Cat, a dimwitted Manx cat who goes by the nickname Stimpy, have a host of unusual adventures.

metas.name: The Penguins of Madagascar
metas.description: The daily adventures of penguins living in New York's Central Park Zoo.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
metas.description: The further adventures of Po the Dragon Warrior and his friends.

metas.name: Doug
metas.description: The life of a young boy as he meets friends, falls in love, maneuvers his way through grade 6 and writes all about it in his journal.

metas.name: KaBlam!
metas.description: An animated anthology show hosted by two kids who live in a comic book.

metas.name: Blue's Clues
metas.description: Blue is a puppy who puts her paw prints on three clues. Steve or Joe has to deduce the clues (with the help of off-screen children) to figure out what Blue wants to do.

metas.name: El Tigre: The Adventures of Manny Rivera
metas.description: The adventures of a 13-year-old Mexican superhero as he deals with school, friendships, bizarre enemies, and his own superhero parents and supervillain grandfather.

metas.name: Making Fiends
metas.description: The evil Vendetta spends much of her time trying to turn Charlotte’s smile upside down, but try as she might, she can’t crush Charlotte’s endless optimism.

metas.name: The X's
metas.description: The escapades of the X's, a family of well trained secret agents gifted in thwarting the forces of evil, yet not so gifted in fitting into everyday life.

metas.name: Catscratch
metas.description: When their owner passes away, three cats, who are brothers that don't resemble each other, inherit a large amount of fortune along with a giant mansion and a very sarcastic butler named Hovis.

metas.name: Tak and the Power of Juju
metas.description: Tak is a preteen shaman tasked with protecting the Pupununu tribe from certain destruction with his newfound gift: the power of juju. With it, he can cast spells, explore new worlds, and summon powerful creatures at the wave of his magic staff. Unfortunately, however, Tak's magic has a habit of causing more trouble than it fixes.

metas.name: Wayside
metas.description: Follow the comically-absurd tales of students on the top floor of Wayside, a quirky grammar school that was accidentally built 30-stories high.

metas.name: Back at the Barnyard
metas.description: A carefree cow named Otis becomes the leader of all of the animals in the barnyard.

metas.name: The Mighty B!
metas.description: Overachieving Honeybee scout, Bessie Higgenbottom, attempts to earn every last Bee Badge.

metas.name: Fanboy & Chum Chum
metas.description: Two children dress up as superheroes and create chaos wherever they go.

metas.name: Sanjay and Craig
metas.description: The always odd and often gross-out adventures of a young boy named Sanjay Patel and his talking pet snake Craig.

metas.name: Harvey Beaks
metas.description: A mild-mannered young bird and his best friends, a pair of rambunctious siblings called Fee and Foo, seek adventure and mischief in the magical forest that they call home.

metas.name: Kappa Mikey
metas.description: Parody of Japanese anime, featuring a guy named Mikey who travels to Japan to star in an anime, where he discovers his new co-stars are all basically walking anime clichés.

metas.name: Planet Sheen
metas.description: Jimmy Neutron's goofy pal, Sheen Estevez, accidentally gets himself sent to another planet, millions of light-years from Earth.

metas.name: Monsters vs. Aliens
metas.description: The further adventures of Susan and her monster friends as they defend Earth from various alien and supernatural threats.

metas.name: Breadwinners
metas.description: Two ducks fly around in a rocket-powered van, delivering bread to other ducks in Pondgea.

metas.name: Rabbids Invasion
metas.description: The Rabbids from Ubisoft's "Raving Rabbids" video game series star in their own television series.

metas.name: Winx Club
metas.description: Bloom finds her secret life in the world of Magix, she and her new friends must unlock new powers to defeat threats and find the truth about Bloom's birth parents.

metas.name: Three Delivery
metas.description: Three orphaned siblings in Chinatown attempt to locate missing recipes with mystical powers, all while doubling as Chinese food delivery couriers.

metas.name: Corneil and Bernie
metas.description: This show contains numerous adventures about just a guy and his talking dog

metas.name: Skyland
metas.description: After Earth's shattering, Seijins inhabit Skyland under the Sphere's dictatorship. When Mahad and Lena's mother is captured, they join rebels fighting the Sphere's control of water.

metas.name: Edgar & Ellen
metas.description: Twin pranksters Edgar and Ellen play jokes on each other and Nod's Limbs residents. Despite backfiring pranks, they torment one another, their pet, and Ellen's nemesis Stephanie.

metas.name: Pig Goat Banana Cricket
metas.description: A series of absurd interwoven stories about four friends and roommates, naive Pig, bohemian Goat, selfish Banana, and mad scientist Cricket.

metas.name: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
metas.description: Four mutant turtle brothers go on adventures where they end up tapping into mystic ninja powers.

metas.name: The Backyardigans
metas.description: Uniqua, Pablo, Tyrone, Tasha, and Austin are a group of young friends who get together to play in the backyard they share. Each day, their imaginations transform that backyard into a different photo-realistic landscape.

metas.name: Oswald
metas.description: A story about a blue octopus and his dog, who looks like a hot dog, called Weenie, and their friends like Daisy the daisy and Henry the penguin.

metas.name: Little Bill
metas.description: A smart, inquisitive five year old boy called "Little Bill" explores what life is like with the help of his big imagination.

metas.name: Dora the Explorer
metas.description: Along with her friend Boots the monkey, Dora goes on adventures.

metas.name: Go, Diego! Go!
metas.description: Diego, a boy who loves nature, helps save animals in trouble with his friend jaguar.

metas.name: Wonder Pets!
metas.description: A turtle, guinea pig, and duckling save the day by using teamwork.

metas.name: Team Umizoomi
metas.description: Pint-sized cartoon superheroes encourage children to use early math concepts to save the day.
